_about: Our crafter (dashboard Storage page -> Our crafter). crafters.<Name> = { on (default false = nothing happens), town (Giran: it crafts only while it stands there and never travels for it), parties: [party leader names] or ["*"] = every party (they take shots from it first in their supply runs: crafter > shop NPC > player shops), stock: { "soulshot:D": target count, ... } (missing / 0 = not made), daily: { D, C, B, A, S crystals, soulOre, spiritOre } per day (0 / missing = no limit), learn (use a recipe scroll from the bag for a missing shot recipe; default false), maxBatches (crafts per round, default 20) }. It never crystallizes anything by itself: it uses the crystals and ore it has and says what is missing (crystallizing = only the items the owner ticks on the Storage page, swarm.js "!crystallize"). Read live by swarm.js every 10 s.
